question: Can the existing causal HPC call gate learn long-horizon invocation value from one-step call interventions scored by detached future rollout regret?

source_checkpoint.reason: C5 calibrated the gate and repaired the negative tail, but its teacher-forced labels did not establish a free-rollout mean gain.

architecture_change.intervention_api: training-only exact alpha_t override for causal branch construction

teacher.reference_trajectory: frozen C5 soft-gated strict free rollout
teacher.intervention: from the identical generated history, force alpha_t=0 or alpha_t=1 at the current candidate step
teacher.continuation_policy: after the intervention, both branches resume the frozen C5 soft neural policy
teacher.target: discounted mean RGB pixel MSE over current plus up to three future rollout predictions

gates: both call-preferred and PFC-preferred examples occur in fit and held episodes
held AUC improves over the frozen C5 head by >= 0.02
held AUC improves over horizon-only by >= 0.02
only existing call-gate head tensors change
future ground-truth reads and writes remain zero
g0_feasibility.decision: Proceed to formal C6 training only if every gate passes.

formal_training_if_g0_passes.loss: class-balanced BCE with mean-normalized absolute benefit weights clipped to [0.5,2.0]
formal_training_if_g0_passes.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 800; no best-validation selection

registered_conditions: C6 hard call at fixed threshold 0.5
acceptance_gates: C6 soft beats paired PFC-only by at least 2% relative
paired-bootstrap 90% lower bound of PFC-only minus C6 soft error is above zero
C6 soft beats C5 soft by at least 0.5% relative
C6 soft episode-gain p10 is no worse than C5 soft
future observation perturbation changes predictions by exactly zero
future ground-truth reads and writes remain zero

decision_rule.success: Freeze C6 as the learned invocation policy and report C3 static as the mechanism control.
decision_rule.teacher_signal_only: If G0 passes but the fresh rollout gates fail, retain the rollout teacher as a diagnostic result and keep C3 as the core model.
decision_rule.stop: If G0 fails, do not spend the formal-training or fresh-blind budget and classify call value as not predictable from the current causal gate features.
